description.zh: 等差数列的通项与倒序相加求和（把两列拼成长方形），等比数列的棋盘麦粒式爆炸增长、部分和与无穷项的极限（|r|<1），以及线性与指数累计的反超月份；最后辨认数列类型。实数数列的纯数学模型。
description.en: The general term of arithmetic sequences and the add-it-backwards sum (two rows form a rectangle), the chessboard-style explosive growth of geometric sequences, partial sums and the infinite limit for |r|<1, the month where exponential accumulation overtakes linear, and finally recognising sequence types. A pure-maths model of real-number sequences.

label.en: The common difference is a slope

reason.zh: 等差数列的各项落在一条直线上，公差 d 就是这条直线每走一步上升的量，即第 0 步的“每次加 d”。
reason.en: The terms of an arithmetic sequence lie on a straight line and the common difference d is how much it rises per step, the “add d each time” of step 0.

label.zh: 求和是积分的离散版本
label.en: A sum is the discrete version of an integral

reason.zh: 第 1 步用长方形面积的一半算出 Sₙ，与积分把连续的量累加成面积是同一种“累加成面积”的想法。
reason.en: Step 1 gets Sₙ as half a rectangle’s area, the same idea as an integral accumulating a continuous quantity into an area.

title.zh: 无穷多项相加为什么能有结果？
title.en: How can infinitely many terms add up to something?
